resources.string: Writes directly to an explicitly identified XP UART, without a SYU Binder command. Reference: profile 0x4012A, g0/r → 2E + packet + checksum. Enter the decoder packet body, not an OEM CAN ID. This does not implement extra cluster layouts/colors.\n\nThe port must already have the entered baud rate and raw 8N1 output. The app does not change it. Disconnecting this app from SYU does not stop the SYU service or release its ports. Use only a UART whose XP wiring and availability you have established. No automatic port selection, root, or retry.
